Callout.Name: Counterfeit Currency - Workshop
Callout.Message: Print workshop found in a unit on an industrial estate.
Callout.Advisory: Presses running, nobody outside the unit.

Script.Line: It is a job. I get paid to run a press.
I have never spent any of it. Look at my shoes and tell me I have spent any of it.
The paper came on a pallet. It was on a pallet and I did not ask.

Lines.Briefing: A press that is running is evidence. Take the room before anybody clears it.
Lines.Approach: The presses are running and there is paper stacked to the roof. Nobody has come out.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
